user_query: I'm a music producer and I'm looking for inspiration for my next project. Can you recommend some unique and experimental songs that push the boundaries of traditional music genres? Additionally, suggest some YouTube channels that feature avant-garde music.

TaskList.description: Research and compile a list of unique and experimental songs across various genres.
Search for YouTube channels that feature avant-garde music and compile a list of recommended channels.
Combine the lists of songs and YouTube channels into a comprehensive report for the user.
